psql: docker exec crypto-quant-signal-mcp-postgres-1 psql -U algovault -d signal_performance
purpose: Pre-cutover per-venue x TF signal counts (BUY/SELL recorded only; the signals table excludes HOLD/low-confidence). The CH4 48h gate compares post-cutover 24h counts against these per-venue totals with FLOOR semantics (>= 0.8x baseline). Migrated to the orchestrator: 5m,15m (CH3) + 30m,1h,2h,4h,8h,12h,1d (CH4). 1m/3m are the shadow + 3m-all17 crons, NOT migrated (control series). HL is intrinsically sparse (38/24h) due to the HOLD/confidence filter, so the gate is FLOOR-relative (vs each venue's own baseline), never absolute.
